# Cascadelist

> Cascadelist is an outliner app: one infinite list you can nest, fold, zoom and link. It is built for writers, researchers, engineers and anyone with too many tabs open in their head.

Every view (outline, board, table) is the same tree underneath. Notes, tasks and daily journal entries live in one place and link to each other with [[wiki links]] and backlinks. It works offline and syncs when you are back online. Available on the web.

## Features

- Infinite nesting: any bullet can hold more bullets. Fold, zoom in, drag to reorder.
- Daily notes: a fresh page every morning; unfinished tasks roll forward automatically.
- [[Links]] and backlinks between bullets; every page knows who references it.
- Mirrors: one bullet in many places, kept in sync.
- Board and table views over the same outline.
- Split pane, version history, keyboard-first (⌘K does almost everything).
- Import Markdown, OPML or plain indented text.

## Pricing

- Free: unlimited bullets, all views, daily notes and backlinks, 7 days of history.
